HEADER: Init +11; Senses Detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, detect law, low-light vision; Perception +14
DEFENSE: AC 22, touch 19, flat-footed 14 (+7 dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural, +1 size)
OFFENSE: Special Attacks Black Wind, Lethe Arrow, Zephyr Arrow
At will (DC 14) - Dancing Lights, Dark Orb, Daze, Ghost Sound
1st (DC 15) - Color Spray, Dark, Enfeeblement, Mage Armor, Silent Image
2nd (DC 16) - Blur, Dark II, Darkness, Jitterbugs, Magic Mouth
STATISTICS: Str 8, Dex 24, Con 13, Int 18, Wis 16, Cha 18
Feats Combat Casting, Dark Focus, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +16, Bluff +14, Escape Artist +16, Fly +22, Knowledge (nature) +15, Perception +13, Sense Motive +14, Stealth +20, Use Magic Device +14
SPECIAL ABILITIES: 1/day, an unseelie spreads dark waves from herself. All creatures within a 30 ft.-radius must make a Reflex save (DC 19) for half damage or take 3d6+12 points of shadow damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 21).
An unseelie gains a +4 luck bonus on all saves against figment-based illusions and compulsion effects.
An unseelie remains invisible even when it attacks. This ability is constant, but the unseelie can suppress or resume it as a free action.

1/day, an unseelie shoots out a blue arrow towards her opponent within 60 ft. The unseelie must makes a ranged touch attack (+13), if it hits, the attack deals 8d6 points of wind damage and inflicts Silence status effect for 1d2 rounds (Will save DC 19 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 25).

1/day, a unseelie surrounds herself in a blueish white breeze within a 30-ft.-radius. This spell functions like Greater Dispel except it only applies the area dispel effect to all the creatures within the area of effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 25).

5/day, an unseelie shoots out a green arrow towards her opponent within 60 ft. The unseelie must makes a ranged touch attack (+13), if it hits, the attack deals 3d6 points of wind damage and knocks her opponent back 10 ft. (Fortitude save DC 19 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 2nd level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 19).

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
